selection_rule: HIM-C: q(v,v)=1, q(v,u)=.1*(.5+.5*h(v)) for graph neighbors, where h is reversed average-tied LDO rank percentile. At each step select global maximum marginal cumulative one-hop independent coverage. CO uses the identical greedy surrogate with q=.1 and ignores HIM.
parameter_policy: Fixed before evaluating outcomes. Uniform parameters across all four graphs; no evaluation probability bank or test outcomes given to selectors. No parameter sweep or stopping based on performance.
scope: Twelve existing checkpoints, same original budgets. New RNG stream evaluates selectors on the unchanged author simulator. This is exploratory reuse of known graphs/encoders, not an unseen-dataset confirmation. Primary contrasts HIM-C-ASW and HIM-C-CO per graph; no pooling across graphs or multiplicity correction. CO is one deterministic set per graph, not three trainings.
